name: duopore-public-neighborhood-criteria-matrix
description: Compare areas using your own ratings for the things that matter to you.

interface.longDescription: Compare areas using your own ratings for the things that matter to you. Give each option a simple label, add your scores and choose how much each factor matters. See the ranking and how the scores add up. This compares your views only. It does not fetch neighborhood facts, use exact locations or judge whether an area is safe.
defaultPrompt: Compare these neighborhood options using my own scores.
Rank these area choices by the factors I care about.

positive.prompt: Use Neighborhood Criteria Matrix with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"criteria":[{"id":"C1","label":"Commute preference","weight":3},{"id":"C2","label":"Space preference","weight":1}],"options":[{"id":"AreaA","scores":[{"criterionRef":"C1","score":8},{"criterionRef":"C2","score":4}]},{"id":"AreaB","scores":[{"criterionRef":"C1","score":5},{"criterionRef":"C2","score":9}]}]}
